tail:
Batch 3 scaffold construction is complete. All deliverables are on disk and all batch-scoped checks pass; the only open items belong to other in-flight batches.

## What was built — `handle-cancellation-slides-and-elementary-moves` (533/534)

**A page, 19 items** (the 15 design items plus 4 added closure prerequisites; B page 5 examples, all design IDs preserved):
- Added prerequisites: `lem-attaching-handles-along-isotopic-attaching-embeddings-preserves-the-diffeomorphism-type`, `lem-transverse-complementary-spheres-have-product-charts`, `lem-standard-complementary-pair-fills-an-n-ball`, `lem-embedded-bands-joining-two-framed-spheres-exist` — these close the gaps the published pages do not cover (attachment isotopy invariance, Wall 4.8.1 normal form, Wall 5.4.2 model + equatorial computation, band existence/framing).
- Definition/theorem chain: geometrically cancelling pair (with the k=0 and k=n−1 endpoint conventions printed) → standard local model → cancellation (Wall 5.4.3 / Lück 1.12) → creation (5.4.4 / 1.13) → slides (band-sum definition with k=1 specialization) → invariance (Wall 5.4.5 diffeotopy) → basis change → matrix → unit entry → elementary operations → algebraic≠geometric gap → Milnor First Cancellation criterion (5.4/5.5/5.6) with trajectory-support control → two scope remarks.
- Every item has explicit `deps`; dependency levels 0–8 (batch-1 drafts raise levels; published suppliers do not); no cycle, no forward edge, no B-leaf dependency.

## Evidence and records
- **Sources**: Wall §5.4 + Lemma 4.8.1, Milnor §§4–6, Lück Ch. 1 §§1.1–1.3 — all fetched as full text, stamped (`source-fetch-check --stamp` 3/3; `url-sweep` 3/3 live). Coverage harvests 36 headings: 11 included, 9 inline, 11 deferred to resolving in-run destinations, 5 out-of-scope with distinct reasons (1 advisory low-yield warning: the read range contains the neighbouring pairs' material).
- **Readiness**: all 24 items recorded `ready` with examined dependency lists and per-item evidence; filtered check shows zero batch-3 blocked rows (whole run still open on other batches: 85 missing records / 32 empty inventories).
- **Cross-batch input**: 12 reviewed rows covering all 12 declared edges (all to batch-1 draft items, `status: open` with required claim/use/owner); unified ledger refreshed.
- **Conflicts recorded in notes**: design's orientation-forward DT-11 and loose `requires` superseded by the plan's exact array and §12.3 reorder (DT-11 is published at 529); Pajitnov Chs. 4–5 contain no cancellation/slide content (full-text search), plan's W+MH matrix used with Lück as third treatment; "no competing broken data" made precise as a single transverse orbit; excess-intersection removal deferred to DT-22 without any forward dependency.
- **Defects**: no new published defect; scripted closure checks confirm none of the §12.7 defective published items is reachable, and the two repaired transversality/tube suppliers in my closure are recorded as repaired in the canonical ledger.

`manifest-deps` 329 items/0 errors; `content-policy --manifest-only` 329/0 errors; `coverage-checklist --require-destination` 0 errors; `validate-plan`, `extcheck`, `fwdcheck`, `drift-review-check` exit 0; `item-dependency-levels` reports no batch-3 error (only other batches' empty inventories).

Remaining, not batch-3 blockers: Step-3 authors must turn the batch-1 supplier contracts into items and reconcile the 12 open ledger rows; Alpha should confirm the 11 declines at Step 5. Readiness is not mathematical approval.
